services.name: Deep Diagnostic & Roadmap
services.description: Find your biggest growth opportunities and leave with a clear plan.

services.name: Endless Customers Coaching
services.description: Build the strategy, habits and internal ownership to grow with the Endless Customers system.
services.note: Most clients start with more frequent support, then adjust the cadence as their needs change.

services.name: Assignment Selling Training
services.description: Help your sales team use educational content to move real conversations forward.
services.note: Requires Endless Customers Coaching. Coaching is counted once in your estimate.

services.name: Content Manager Onboarding & Training
services.description: Develop one in-house content manager through practice, feedback and a tailored learning plan.
services.note: Requires Endless Customers Coaching. Your team owns content production.

services.name: Videographer Onboarding & Training
services.description: Build in-house skills in planning, filming, editing and using video in sales and marketing.
services.note: Requires Endless Customers Coaching. Your team owns video production.

services.name: Website Redesigns
services.description: Build a buyer-focused website and learn how to manage it.
services.note: Project budget; billed monthly on an agreed schedule. Scope determines the final price.

services.name: Website Optimization
services.description: Develop your team’s ability to improve the website you already have.
services.note: Assessment and setup in month one. Design and development are scoped separately.

services.name: Learning Centers
services.description: Help buyers find the answers they need in an organized resource library.

services.name: Self-Service Tools
services.description: Give buyers a useful calculator, assessment or other decision tool.
services.note: Tool builds require a separate strategy engagement. We review any discovery already covered in a larger scope.

services.name: HubSpot Onboarding
services.description: Get started with the hubs you use. Add each hub separately.
services.note: Multiple hubs are an unadjusted budget. Shared setup is reviewed before a quote.

services.name: HubSpot Admin Onboarding
services.description: Teach your internal administrator to own your portal and support your team.
services.note: Available standalone. No Endless Customers Coaching prerequisite.

services.name: HubSpot Implementation
services.description: Get your core CRM and workflows working through a do-it-with-you approach.
services.note: Billed monthly over the planned implementation. Duration describes the work, not a minimum commitment.

services.name: HubSpot Training
services.description: Help your team use HubSpot confidently in their day-to-day work.

services.name: HubSpot Workshops
services.description: Bring your team together for focused, hands-on learning.

services.name: HubSpot Integrations
services.description: Connect the systems your business relies on.
services.note: These are planning ranges. Every integration requires a custom scope and quote; software fees are additional.

services.name: HubSpot Web Development
services.description: Build a full website or add the pages, templates and modules your team needs.
services.note: Full websites use the same packages as Website Redesigns. Selecting the same package in both categories never adds a second fee.

services.name: Paid Media Audits
services.description: Understand where your current campaigns can improve.

services.name: Paid Media Management
services.description: Get a team to run and improve your paid campaigns.
services.note: Ad spend is paid separately to the platforms. Management eligibility and fees depend on monthly spend.

services.name: Paid Media Consulting
services.description: Get expert direction while your internal team manages the campaigns.
